name: KMS silent key policy is fail-closed UNKNOWN (inverted vs S3)
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 115. A key policy that grants only a specific same-account role (KeyAdmin) and OMITS the account-delegation ('Enable IAM User Permissions') statement means IAM identity policies CANNOT govern this key - unlike S3, where an absent bucket policy still lets the account's IAM policies grant access. Only key-policy-named principals can use the key; per-principal effective access is fail-closed UNKNOWN from the key policy alone. The direct same-account grant is reported (RESOURCE-SAME-ACCOUNT-GRANT medium) plus a KMS-SILENT-POLICY-UNKNOWN coverage-style finding that notes kms:PutKeyPolicy = key-policy takeover.

KMS-SILENT-POLICY-UNKNOWN: can still grant access to this key
